quality.review_scope: Source-scoped contribution based on actual full text and original-page visual reading of main pages 1-6. General preparation, individual optical/size contexts and analytical interpretations are distinct. No formal complete-paper Reader or external-reference coverage is claimed.
missing_fields: Local source scope is the six-page main article; matching SI is unavailable locally. Cited external methods and data are not imported.
Commercial input surface-ligand structures, solvents and detailed solution compositions are unreported. No acid/base identity, particle atom coordinates or exact stoichiometry is invented.
Recipe-to-measurement context does not establish an exact shared physical batch; individual figure and specimen assignments retain their source scope.
Source curves are not digitized; optical spot size, pixel-profile coordinates and particle diameter are distinct quantities.
Source geometric formula uses optical spot500 nm and bare Au470 nm, not the about490 nm physical coated diameter.
No numeric core/shell ratio or independent cavity-radius value imported from external references.
conflicts: Main PDF p.4 Section 3.5 reports Q=80, lambda=625 nm, n approximately2.07 and Veff approximately223^3 nm^3, then F=1.51. Direct substitution into its printed formula gives approximately15.09. Both the source result and explicitly labelled extractor arithmetic check are retained; no experimental value is silently repaired.
